critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/special_order_phase2.py lock_price(): reads pv from pricing_preview which pulls cost from decided sample every call — after unlock the previously-locked cost_price is discarded. If this is intentional it's fine; otherwise consider snapshotting the cost inside the pricing subdocument on first lock and reusing it unless margin_pct or supplier change.

backend/routers/special_orders.py unlock-price: status_code 403 logic uses `400 if user.get('role')=='admin' else 403` — meaning non-admin always gets 403 regardless of ODError kind, which happens to satisfy the manager-blocked case but hides ODError types like 'PR/SO already generated'. Consider explicit role check first (raise 403 immediately) and 400 only for admin-side validation errors.

backend/services/special_order_phase2.py customer_decide(): revisi flow sets sets['customer_decision']=''; effectively erases the previous customer_decision even though the entry is recorded in customer_decisions. UI relies on this fine, but downstream code checking `od.customer_decision == 'acc'` in lock_price is correct only because ACC is the last transition — worth documenting.
